settings.title: Measure each nail
settings.text: Lay a soft tape or a strip of paper across the widest part of each nail, side to side.

settings.title: Note it in mm
settings.text: Write down all five widths, thumb to little finger.

settings.title: Match the chart
settings.text: Pick the size whose widths are closest to yours.

settings.heading: Size guide
settings.intro: Four sizes, XS to L. Here's how to find yours.
settings.exchange: If a size doesn't fit, tell us within [exchange_window] of delivery and we'll exchange it free.
